stem: Contamination appears mostly after one operator's transfers and clusters by work session. Which interpretation is strongest?
choices: The pattern supports investigating operator/session-specific process control before blaming media composition
Media composition is proven to be the cause
The contamination is random because all cultures share the same room
The affected cultures should be relabeled as clean
rationale: Clustering by operator or session is useful process evidence and should trigger targeted review of aseptic technique and handling conditions.
